samples.question: One connected navy ribbon runs inside the pale route window from a red start cap to a green end cap. Follow it from red to green and treat each of its 32 successive sections as one width sample. Apply a three-sample box blur to the width sequence, then read the 32 blurred samples row-major as a 4-by-8 bitmap. Which displayed template is closer: A) BOW = 10011001/01100110/01100110/10011001 or B) HARP = 11100111/10000001/10000001/11100111? Use Hamming distance, choose A on a tie, and quarantine ties. Ignore the caps, window, and background.
